data.name: Export a Digital Assistant to Object Storage
data.description: Exports the specified Digital Assistant as an archive to Object Storage.
data.evaluateGuide:
Exports a specified Digital Assistant as an archive to Oracle Object Storage. Use the endpoint to create an export for later storage or retrieval.
Use for: Export a Digital Assistant, archive assistant data, save an assistant export
Not supported: Importing assistants, editing assistants, downloading archive content

data.name: Retrieve a File (Object storage)
data.description:
Retrieves the file object for a specific file id. The response includes a temporary signed download_url (valid ~5 minutes) to download the file content.
Documentation: https://developers.freshworks.com/docs/app-sdk/v3.0/cpq_document/data-store/object-storage/
Quick Start:
- Call GET /crm/sales/api/documents/{{fileId}} to retrieve file metadata and a short-lived download_url.
Parameters Explained:
- fileId (required, path): File identifier returned on upload.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 404 Not Found: fileId incorrect or file was deleted/expired. Fix: confirm id via list endpoint.
Edge Cases:
- downloadurl is signed and valid only for a short time (doc says ~5 minutes). Request a fresh GET for a new downloadurl when needed.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- None documented beyond general request limits for the platform.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves metadata for a specific Freshsales file and provides a short-lived URL for downloading its content.
Use for: Retrieve file metadata, obtain a download URL, download a stored file
Not supported: Uploading files, deleting files, listing files

data.name: Delete a File (Object storage)
data.description:
Deletes a specific file identified by its file id. Returns a success message on deletion.
Documentation: https://developers.freshworks.com/docs/app-sdk/v3.0/cpq_document/data-store/object-storage/
Quick Start:
- Call DELETE /crm/sales/api/documents/{{fileId}} with appropriate authorization.
Parameters Explained:
- fileId (required, path): Identifier of the file to delete.
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 404 Not Found: fileId incorrect or already deleted. Verify id via list endpoint.
- 401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden: missing or invalid credentials. Ensure API key or token is correct.
Edge Cases:
- If a file had an expires_at scheduled, deleting before or after expiry may return Not Found if already deleted by expiry job.
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- Deletion is subject to standard API rate limits; no special quotas documented for deletions.
data.evaluateGuide:
Deletes a specific file from Freshsales object storage using its file identifier.
Use for: Delete a stored file, remove an expired file, remove an unwanted document
Not supported: Retrieving files, uploading files, listing files
